blocks.text: SYDNEY — The Pentagon has assigned the USS Colorado as the first US nuclear-powered attack submarine to join a rotating force to be based in western Australia. The 377-foot (115-metre) Virginia-Class submarine, armed with land-attack missiles and sophisticated torpedoes, will sail to the new Australian base in late 2027, officials said Tuesday. The deployment is a “significant milestone” in building up a joint US-Australia-UK deterrence in the Pacific under their AUKUS defense pact, the allies said in a joint statement.
